title: .crpatcher config
description: The .crpatcher file is a YAML file defining configuration for the crpatcher tool.

repo_dir.description: The path to the repository directory.

patch_dir.description: The path to the patch directory.

patchinfo.description: The configuration for the patchinfo file.

version.description: The version of the patchinfo file. Default: 1

encoding.description: The encoding of the patchinfo file. Default: utf-8

ext.description: The extension of the patchinfo file. Default: patchinfo

patch.description: The configuration for the patch file.

encoding.description: The encoding of the patchinfo file. Default: utf-8

ext.description: The extension of the patch file. Default: patch

replacement_separator.description: The replacement separator of the patch file. Default: -. For example, given base/win/embedded_i18n/create_string.cc, its patch will be base-win-embedded_i18n-create_string.cc.patch
